Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the time on the call this morning. As discussed, I’m sharing a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that frames the pilot success criteria, technical checkpoints, and a proposed 45-day decision runway. The doc is editable so we can co-author with your stakeholders.

What I shared:
- MAP_template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc link below) — includes acceptance criteria, milestones, owners, and escalation lanes.
- pilot_timeline_v1.xlsx attached — a simple week-by-week activity plan (dev, test, demo, decision).

Quick asks:
1) Can you add the primary technical owner and procurement lead from your side in the doc?
2) Are there any hard blackout dates for system access this quarter?

GDoc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cMAP_TEMPLATE
Attachment: (Attachment: pilot_timeline_v1.xlsx [spreadsheet])

I’ll schedule a 30-min working session for Wed to walk through the MAP and lock owners.

Best,
Evelyn

Thanks Alicia — great to have procurement on the thread. I made a few edit suggestions directly in MAP_template_v1.gdoc:
- Added a short procurement appendix that outlines billing cadence (monthly in arrears) and a simple early-termination clause for pilots.
- Inserted a security checklist row (SOC 2, data retention, access controls). Evelyn — can you drop the SOC 2 link/pointer in the doc (or attach a stub) so procurement can pull it into their review?
- Suggested two demo windows: Week 3 (technical demo) and Week 5 (business review). We can move these if they conflict with your conference.

I attached a one-page PDF with redline comments for easy offline review. Also: who will own the acceptance test cases from Lumenica (Luis or another engineer)? We should call that out as an owner in the MAP.

Next steps I propose:
1) Wed 10:00–10:30 PT working session to walk edits and confirm owners (Evelyn to send invite).
2) Procurement to review appendix and provide any standard PO timelines by Friday.
3) We’ll publish a final MAP v1 by next Monday after the meeting.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: MAP_redline_notes.pdf [PDF])

Alicia / team — thanks for the quick collaboration. I reviewed the edits in the doc and agree with Marissa’s approach. Two operational items to lock today so we can get to a final MAP v1:

1) Owners (please confirm in the doc):
- Lumenica technical owner: Luis Ramos (confirmed by Alicia)
- Redwood SRE owner: Ben Carter (I’ll loop Ben on onboarding access)
- Success/acceptance owner: Marissa Cole

2) Timeline & decision runway:
- Proposed decision window: 45 days from pilot kickoff (kickoff target: Mar 8).
- Key milestones: week-by-week in pilot_timeline_v1.xlsx (dev, sandbox validation, technical demo, business demo, decision review).

3) Compliance evidence: Evelyn — please attach the SOC 2 pointer (or stub) into the MAP doc and link to the audit attestation we can share with procurement. Procurement — if you have a standard PO template or vendor security attestation, please drop it in the doc.

4) Signature / approval: once owners and procurement terms are confirmed, we can push the MAP for signature. I’ve created a DocuSign envelope to streamline approvals: https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABC123-Lumenica

I’ll host the Wed 10:00 PT working session invite now (calendar invite sent). Looking forward to locking v1.

Jonas Weber
